generatedScripts.downloadClientsSetup:
export CURL_BIN="/nix/store/4vsdl8irmr0bcdm2bpdv22w5w088zf84-curl-8.19.0-bin/bin/curl"
export JQ_BIN="/nix/store/qq7kkpgsdfkq4xdgvwgdibvcqicwvd7a-jq-1.8.1-bin/bin/jq"
source /nix/store/rh0h60iiqsbj6i14zjqdar9drwgnj7h2-systemd_helpers.sh
set -euo pipefail

echo "Starting download client connections..."

# Wait for all APIs to be ready
wait_for_api_basic_auth "NZBGet" "http://localhost:6789/" 60 "admin" "/run/secrets/sabnzbd_admin_password"
wait_for_api "SABnzbd" "http://localhost:8085/api?mode=version&apikey=$(cat /run/secrets/sabnzbd_api_key)" 60
# wait_for_api "qBittorrent" "http://localhost:8080/api/v2/app/version" 30

# Configure qBittorrent for arr services
setup_qbittorrent_client "Sonarr" "8989" "/run/secrets/sonarr_api_key" "tvCategory" "tv" "/run/secrets/qbittorrent_admin_password"

setup_qbittorrent_client "Radarr" "7878" "/run/secrets/radarr_api_key" "movieCategory" "movies" "/run/secrets/qbittorrent_admin_password"

# Verify SABnzbd categories are configured
echo "Verifying SABnzbd categories..."
CATEGORIES=$($CURL_BIN -s "http://localhost:8085/api?mode=get_cats&apikey=$(cat /run/secrets/sabnzbd_api_key)")

if echo "$CATEGORIES" | grep -q '"tv"' && echo "$CATEGORIES" | grep -q '"movies"'; then
  echo "✓ SABnzbd categories configured correctly"
else
  echo "⚠ Warning: SABnzbd categories may not be configured correctly"
fi

# Configure NZBGet as the default Usenet client for arr services
setup_nzbget_client "Sonarr" "8989" "/run/secrets/sonarr_api_key" "tvCategory" "tv" "/run/secrets/sabnzbd_admin_password" 1

setup_nzbget_client "Radarr" "7878" "/run/secrets/radarr_api_key" "movieCategory" "movies" "/run/secrets/sabnzbd_admin_password" 1

# Keep SABnzbd available as a lower-priority Usenet fallback
setup_sabnzbd_client "Sonarr" "8989" "/run/secrets/sonarr_api_key" "tvCategory" "tv" "/run/secrets/sabnzbd_api_key" 2

setup_sabnzbd_client "Radarr" "7878" "/run/secrets/radarr_api_key" "movieCategory" "movies" "/run/secrets/sabnzbd_api_key" 2

# Add Usenet clients to Prowlarr with NZBGet as the default
add_nzbget_to_prowlarr "/run/secrets/sabnzbd_admin_password" "/run/secrets/prowlarr_api_key" 1

add_sabnzbd_to_prowlarr "/run/secrets/sabnzbd_api_key" "/run/secrets/prowlarr_api_key" 2

echo "✓ Completed download client connections"
generatedScripts.mediaConfig:
export CURL_BIN="/nix/store/4vsdl8irmr0bcdm2bpdv22w5w088zf84-curl-8.19.0-bin/bin/curl"
source /nix/store/rh0h60iiqsbj6i14zjqdar9drwgnj7h2-systemd_helpers.sh
set -euo pipefail

echo "Starting media services configuration (Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, qBittorrent, NZBGet, SABnzbd)..."

# Deploy arr service configurations
configure_arr sonarr /run/secrets/rendered/sonarr-config.xml
configure_arr radarr /run/secrets/rendered/radarr-config.xml
configure_arr prowlarr /run/secrets/rendered/prowlarr-config.xml
configure_arr nzbget /run/secrets/rendered/nzbget.conf
configure_arr sabnzbd /run/secrets/rendered/sabnzbd.ini

# Deploy qBittorrent configuration
echo "Configuring qBittorrent..."
CONFIG_DIR="/var/lib/qbittorrent/qBittorrent/config"
CONFIG_FILE="$CONFIG_DIR/qBittorrent.conf"
TEMP_FILE="$CONFIG_DIR/qBittorrent.conf.tmp"

mkdir -p "$CONFIG_DIR"
chown qbittorrent:qbittorrent "$CONFIG_DIR"

# Remove existing config to avoid conflicts
if [ -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]; then
  rm -f "$CONFIG_FILE"
fi

# Atomic deployment
cp /run/secrets/rendered/qbittorrent.conf "$TEMP_FILE"
chown qbittorrent:qbittorrent "$TEMP_FILE"
chmod 600 "$TEMP_FILE"
mv "$TEMP_FILE" "$CONFIG_FILE"
echo "✓ qBittorrent configuration deployed"

echo "✓ Completed media services configuration"
